meals.recipe_name: Loaded Scrambled Egg & Turkey Breakfast Burrito
recipe_steps: 1. Make the tortilla: In a bowl combine 1.25 cups flour and 0.5 tsp salt. Add 2 tbsp olive oil and 0.5 cup warm water. Mix, then knead 5 minutes into a smooth dough. Cover and rest 20 minutes (or use pre-rested dough from prep).
2. Divide dough in half (save half for another use or make one large 12-inch tortilla). Roll one portion into a thin 10-inch round on a floured surface.
3. Heat a dry skillet over medium-high (about 400°F). Cook tortilla 45 seconds per side until puffed and lightly browned. Wrap in a towel to keep pliable.
4. Dice 0.5 bell pepper. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat with 1 tbsp butter.
5. Add 4 oz ground turkey, season with salt, and cook 4-5 minutes breaking apart until no pink remains and lightly browned.
6. Add diced pepper, cook 2 minutes. Beat 4 eggs and pour in; scramble gently 2-3 minutes until just set.
7. Sprinkle 1 oz cheddar over eggs, let melt 30 seconds.
8. Lay filling down the center of the tortilla, top with 2 tbsp salsa, fold in sides and roll tight. Sear seam-side down in the skillet 1 minute. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 4 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Sunday night to thaw for Monday breakfast.
Combine 1.25 cups flour, 0.5 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, cover, rest in fridge overnight; bring to room temp before rolling.

meals.recipe_name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
recipe_steps: 1. Whisk 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger into a teriyaki sauce.
2. Cut 6 oz chicken thighs into bite-size pieces. Heat 1 tsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Sear chicken 5-6 minutes until browned and cooked to 165°F internal.
4. Pour in the teriyaki sauce; simmer 2 minutes until glossy and coating the chicken.
5. Steam 1 cup broccoli in the microwave 2 minutes with a splash of water.
6. Plate 1.5 cups warm rice, top with glazed chicken and broccoli. Drizzle pan sauce, sprinkle sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday lunch.
Cook 2 cups dry white rice in 3 cups water; cool and refrigerate for the week's bowls (use within 3-4 days).

meals.recipe_name: Seared Salmon with Garlic Mashed Potatoes and Asparagus
recipe_steps: 1. Peel and cube 2 potatoes; boil in salted water 15 minutes until fork-tender.
2. Drain and mash with 2 tbsp butter, 0.25 cup milk, 2 minced garlic cloves, salt and pepper. Keep warm.
3. Pat salmon dry, season both sides with salt and pepper.
4. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Place salmon skin-side down; sear 4 minutes without moving.
5. Flip and cook 3 more minutes to 125-130°F internal for medium. Squeeze lemon over top.
6. Toss asparagus with a little oil and salt; roast in same pan 4 minutes or broil until tender-crisp.
7. Plate mash, salmon, and asparagus.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner, or cold-water thaw Monday afternoon ~45 min.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Berry Protein Bowl
recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
2. Top with 0.75 cup berries, 0.25 cup granola, and 1 oz chopped almonds.
3. Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Toast with Honey and Walnuts
recipe_steps: 1. Toast 2 slices of bread until golden.
2. Spread 0.75 cup cottage cheese over the toast.
3. Top with 1 oz crushed walnuts, drizzle 1 tbsp honey, dust with cinnamon. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Mix 3.5 cups bread flour, 1.25 cups warm water, 2 tsp yeast, 2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp honey. Knead 8 min, rise 1.5 hr, shape into a loaf, proof 45 min, bake at 425°F for 30 min. Cool; slice as needed through the week.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Overnight Oats with Banana and Peanut Butter
recipe_steps: 1. In a jar combine 1 cup oats, 1 cup milk, 1 scoop protein powder, 1 tbsp chia seeds. Stir well.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight (prep task).
3. In the morning, top with sliced banana and 2 tbsp peanut butter. Stir and eat cold, or microwave 60 seconds if preferred warm.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday night, combine 1 cup rolled oats, 1 cup milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 tbsp chia seeds in a jar; stir, cover, refrigerate for Tuesday breakfast.

meals.recipe_name: Tuna Nicoise-Style Power Salad
recipe_steps: 1. Boil 2 eggs 9 minutes; cool in ice water, peel, halve.
2. Boil baby potatoes 12 minutes until tender; drain. Blanch green beans in the same water 3 minutes; drain.
3. Whisk 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dijon, juice of 0.5 lemon, salt and pepper into a dressing.
4. Arrange 2 cups greens, potatoes, green beans, olives, drained tuna, and eggs on a plate.
5. Drizzle dressing over everything and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Beef and Black Bean Chili with Cornbread
recipe_steps: 1. Make cornbread: mix 0.75 cup cornmeal, 0.5 cup flour, 1.5 tsp baking powder, 0.5 tsp salt. Add 1 egg, 0.5 cup milk, 1 tbsp oil. Pour into a greased pan; bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.
2. Dice 0.5 onion, mince 2 garlic cloves. Brown 7 oz ground beef in a pot over medium-high 5 minutes.
3. Add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp chili powder and 1 tsp cumin, toast 30 seconds.
4. Add 1 cup diced tomatoes and 1 cup black beans. Simmer 12 minutes until thickened.
5. Serve chili hot with a wedge of fresh cornbread.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ground beef from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Protein Shake with Oats
recipe_steps: 1. Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 0.33 cup oats, 1 banana, 1 tbsp peanut butter to a blender.
2. Blend 45 seconds until smooth. Serve cold.

meals.recipe_name: Cheese and Turkey Roll-Ups with Crackers
recipe_steps: 1. Slice 2 oz cheddar into sticks; roll each with a slice of turkey.
2. Slice cucumber into rounds.
3. Plate roll-ups with crackers and cucumber. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Shakshuka with Feta and Homemade Pita
recipe_steps: 1. Make pita: mix 1.25 cups bread flour, 1 tsp yeast, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.5 cup warm water, 1 tbsp oil. Knead 6 min, rise 1 hr. Roll into rounds; bake at 475°F for 5 min until puffed (use prep dough).
2. Dice 0.5 onion and 0.5 bell pepper, mince 2 garlic. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium.
3. Sauté onion and pepper 5 minutes; add garlic, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, cook 1 minute.
4. Add 1.5 cups diced tomatoes; simmer 8 minutes until thick.
5. Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 6 minutes until whites set.
6. Crumble 2 oz feta over top. Serve with warm pita.

prep_tasks.instructions: Tuesday night, mix 1.25 cups bread flour, 1 tsp yeast, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.5 cup warm water, 1 tbsp oil. Knead 6 min, cover, cold-ferment in fridge overnight; bring to room temp before rolling.

meals.recipe_name: Shrimp Fried Rice
recipe_steps: 1. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a wok over high heat. Scramble 2 eggs; remove and set aside.
2. Add shrimp, cook 2-3 minutes until pink; remove.
3. Add minced garlic and 0.75 cup peas/carrots, stir-fry 2 minutes.
4. Add 1.5 cups cold cooked rice, breaking up clumps; stir-fry 3 minutes.
5. Return eggs and shrimp; add 2 tbsp soy sauce and sliced green onion. Toss 1 minute and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch, or cold-water thaw Wednesday morning ~15 min.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Tenderloin with Sweet Potato and Brussels Sprouts
recipe_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Cube sweet potato and halve brussels sprouts; toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper on a sheet pan.
2. Roast vegetables 25 minutes, stirring halfway.
3. Season pork tenderloin with salt, pepper, rosemary, minced garlic. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high 3 minutes per side.
4. Brush pork with 1 tbsp maple syrup and finish in the oven 12 minutes to 145°F internal.
5. Rest pork 5 minutes, slice, and serve with roasted vegetables.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple and Almonds
recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
2. Top with 0.75 cup pineapple, 1 oz almonds, and drizzle 1 tsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Protein Shake with Peanut Butter Toast
recipe_steps: 1. Blend 1 cup milk with 1 scoop vanilla protein powder 30 seconds.
2. Toast 2 slices bread; spread with 2 tbsp peanut butter.
3. Serve toast with the shake.

meals.recipe_name: Bison Breakfast Hash with Fried Eggs
recipe_steps: 1. Dice potato, pepper, and onion. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high.
2. Add potato; cook 8 minutes until browning, stirring occasionally.
3. Add pepper and onion, cook 4 minutes. Push to the side.
4. Add 5 oz ground bison, season with paprika, salt, pepper; brown 5 minutes until cooked through.
5. In a separate pan fry 3 eggs to desired doneness. Plate hash topped with eggs.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday breakfast.

meals.recipe_name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipe_steps: 1. Roll rested tortilla dough into a 10-inch round; cook 45 seconds per side in a dry skillet at 400°F.
2. Season 6 oz chicken breast with salt and pepper. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high 5-6 minutes per side to 165°F. Slice.
3. Toss 2 cups chopped romaine with 2 tbsp caesar dressing and 1 oz parmesan.
4. Fill tortilla with salad and sliced chicken; roll tight and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday lunch.
Wednesday night, mix 1.25 cups flour, 0.5 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, cover, rest in fridge overnight; room temp before rolling.

meals.recipe_name: Beef Stir-Fry with Bell Peppers over Rice
recipe_steps: 1. Slice flank steak thin against the grain; toss with 1 tsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
2. Mix sauce: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, minced garlic, 1 tsp grated ginger.
3. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a wok over high heat. Sear beef 2 minutes; remove.
4. Stir-fry sliced pepper and broccoli 3 minutes.
5. Return beef, add sauce, toss 1 minute until glossy. Serve over 1.5 cups rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Granola and Honey
recipe_steps: 1. Layer half the yogurt in a glass, then half the granola and berries.
2. Repeat layers; drizzle with 1 tbsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Avocado
recipe_steps: 1. Drain tuna; mix with 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, juice of 0.5 lemon, diced celery, salt and pepper.
2. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out a little flesh to widen the well.
3. Fill each avocado half with tuna salad. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Berries
recipe_steps: 1. Blend 0.5 cup oats, 2 eggs, 1 scoop protein powder, 1 banana, 0.5 tsp baking powder into a batter.
2. Heat 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium.
3. Pour 3-inch pancakes; cook 2 minutes until bubbles form, flip, cook 1.5 minutes.
4. Stack pancakes, top with 0.5 cup Greek yogurt, 0.5 cup berries, and 1 tbsp maple syrup.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey and Cheddar Smash Burger with Sweet Potato Fries
recipe_steps: 1. Make bun: mix 1 cup bread flour, 1 tsp yeast, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.33 cup warm water, 1 tbsp oil. Knead, rise 1 hr, shape into a bun, proof 30 min, brush with egg, bake at 375°F for 15 min (use prep dough).
2. Cut sweet potato into fries; toss with 1 tbsp oil and salt. Roast at 425°F for 22 minutes.
3. Form 7 oz turkey into a loose ball. Smash onto a hot skillet, season, cook 3 minutes, flip.
4. Add cheddar, cook 2 more minutes to 165°F.
5. Assemble burger on bun with lettuce and tomato. Serve with fries.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday lunch.
Thursday night, mix 1 cup bread flour, 1 tsp yeast, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.33 cup warm water, 1 tbsp oil. Knead 6 min, cover, cold-ferment in fridge overnight; shape and proof Friday before baking.

meals.recipe_name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
recipe_steps: 1. Boil linguine in salted water per package (about 9 minutes) to al dente; reserve 0.5 cup pasta water.
2. Melt 2 tbsp butter with 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium. Add minced garlic, cook 30 seconds.
3. Add shrimp, cook 2-3 minutes until pink. Add halved cherry tomatoes, cook 2 minutes.
4. Add drained pasta, splash of pasta water, juice of 0.5 lemon, and 1 oz parmesan. Toss to emulsify.
5. Finish with chopped parsley. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday dinner, or cold-water thaw Friday afternoon ~15 min.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Shake
recipe_steps: 1. Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana 45 seconds. Serve cold.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Cucumber and Everything Seasoning
recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
2. Top with diced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, and 1 tsp everything seasoning.
3. Serve with crackers.

meals.recipe_name: Smoked Salmon Bagel with Scrambled Eggs
recipe_steps: 1. Shape bagel dough into a ring; boil 30 seconds per side, then bake at 425°F for 18 minutes (use prep dough).
2. Whisk 3 eggs; scramble gently in 1 tbsp butter over low heat 3 minutes until creamy.
3. Slice bagel, toast, and spread 2 tbsp cream cheese.
4. Top with scrambled eggs, 3 oz smoked salmon, red onion, and 1 tsp capers. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Friday night, mix 1.25 cups bread flour, 1 tsp yeast, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 0.5 cup warm water. Knead 8 min, cover, cold-ferment in fridge overnight; shape and boil/bake Saturday morning.

meals.recipe_name: Korean Beef Bibimbap
recipe_steps: 1. Brown 6 oz ground beef with minced garlic and 2 tbsp soy sauce over medium-high 6 minutes.
2. Julienne carrot and cucumber. Wilt 1 cup spinach in a hot pan 1 minute.
3. Fry 1 egg sunny-side up.
4. Plate 1.5 cups rice; arrange beef and vegetables in sections around the bowl.
5. Top with fried egg and 1 tbsp gochujang mixed with 1 tsp sesame oil. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz ground beef from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Herb-Roasted Chicken Thighs with Couscous and Roasted Veg
recipe_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, thyme, minced garlic.
2. Sear thighs skin-side down in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes, flip, then roast 20 minutes to 175°F.
3. Toss chopped zucchini and cherry tomatoes with 1 tbsp oil; roast alongside 18 minutes.
4. Bring 1 cup chicken broth to a boil, stir in 0.75 cup couscous, cover, off heat 5 minutes; fluff.
5. Plate couscous, chicken, and vegetables. Squeeze lemon over. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz bone-in chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt with Honey, Walnuts and Dark Chocolate
recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
2. Top with 1 oz walnuts, 1 tbsp dark chocolate chips, and 1 tbsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Hummus and Veggies
recipe_steps: 1. Boil 3 eggs 9 minutes; cool in ice water and peel.
2. Slice carrot and pepper into sticks.
3. Serve eggs with 0.33 cup hummus, veggies, and crackers.

meals.recipe_name: Denver Omelette with Cheese and Home Fries
recipe_steps: 1. Dice potato; pan-fry in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high 10 minutes until crispy, season with salt.
2. Dice ham, pepper, onion. Sauté in 1 tbsp butter 3 minutes; remove.
3. Beat 4 eggs; pour into the pan over medium-low, cook 2 minutes until edges set.
4. Add ham-veggie mix and 1 oz cheddar to one half; fold omelette over.
5. Cook 1 more minute. Serve with home fries.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 3 oz ham from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday breakfast.

meals.recipe_name: Salmon Poke Bowl
recipe_steps: 1. Cube 6 oz sushi-grade salmon. Toss with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, sliced green onion. Rest 5 minutes.
2. Season 1.5 cups warm rice with 1 tbsp rice vinegar; let cool slightly.
3. Slice avocado, cucumber, and julienne carrot.
4. Assemble rice in a bowl, arrange salmon and vegetables on top.
5. Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz sushi-grade salmon from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch. Keep well chilled and use promptly for raw preparation.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Chop with Apple Cider Glaze, Rice and Green Beans
recipe_steps: 1. Pat pork chop dry, season with salt, pepper, thyme.
2. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high 4 minutes per side to 145°F. Rest.
3. In the same pan, add 0.5 cup apple cider, 1 tsp dijon, minced garlic; reduce 3 minutes. Swirl in 1 tbsp butter.
4. Steam 1.5 cups green beans 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
5. Plate rice, pork chop, green beans; drizzle cider glaze over chop. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz bone-in pork chop from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Protein Shake with Oats and Almond Butter
recipe_steps: 1. Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein, 0.33 cup oats, 1 tbsp almond butter, 1 banana 45 seconds. Serve cold.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Pancake Bites with Berries
recipe_steps: 1. Blend 0.5 cup cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 0.5 cup oats into a batter.
2. Heat 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium.
3. Cook small pancake bites 2 minutes per side.
4. Top with 0.5 cup berries and 1 tbsp maple syrup. Serve.
